title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Service Area, Covered Services and Covered Providers
content:
## Scope settings of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care)

These settings are the same on every tier (Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care; Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL); Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL); Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL); Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL); Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL)) except the BadgerCare Plus screening flag:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Counties of residence that meet the residency requirement | Outagamie, Winnebago, Calumet, Fond du Lac, Waupaca, Shawano |
| Residence in the service area required for non-emergency services | yes |
| Emergency services covered regardless of residence | yes |
| Elective non-covered services excluded from assistance | yes |
| Patient-responsibility balances of insured patients (deductible, coinsurance, copay, non-covered) eligible | yes |
| Providers whose charges the award covers | Riverbend Regional Health hospital facilities; Riverbend Medical Group employed physicians |
| Providers practicing at Riverbend whose charges the award does not cover | Fox Valley Emergency Physicians; Lakeshore Anesthesia Associates; Northeast Wisconsin Radiology Consultants |

## BadgerCare Plus screening before approval

| Tier | Applicant must complete a BadgerCare Plus eligibility screening before approval |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care | no |
| Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | yes |
| Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL) | yes |
| Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL) | yes |
| Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL) | no |
| Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) | no |
